title: [Traveler Profile API - PUT /api/traveler/update-profile] Malformed dob String Triggers Unhandled HTTP 500 Internal Server Error Instead of 4xx Validation Error
environment: Staging (STAG) · Strapi Backend API & Desktop 1440×900 · Chrome · en-US · FE=turbopack-2h-u0he6dowwt, BE=<CHECK_DEPLOYED_SHA> (https://web.stag.goodnstay.com/en-US/user-profile/profile-details)
test_account: Signed-In QA Traveler Session on Staging (Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_QA_TOKEN>)
steps_to_reproduce: Load the complete valid profile fixture (fixtures/valid-update-profile.json: fullName='QA Tester', phone='+84900000000', country='VN', dob='2000-01-15', gender='male') and confirm baseline PUT returns HTTP 200 OK.
Single-Variable Mutation: Clone fixtures/valid-update-profile.json and change ONLY dob from '2000-01-15' to 'not-a-valid-date' (fixtures/update-profile-malformed-dob.json).
Record the HTTP status code and error body, then execute GET https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/traveler/me readback to verify stored profile integrity.
actual_result: - PUT /api/traveler/update-profile with dob='not-a-valid-date' fails with unhandled HTTP 500 Internal Server Error: {"success": false, "error": {"code": 500, "message": "Server error.", "details": []}}.
expected_result:
- Per OpenAPI Governance 4xx vs 5xx Separation (Confluence 144015744) and same-endpoint validation parity (where invalid gender returns HTTP 422 {"code": 422, "message": "Invalid input.", "details": ["gender:gender_invalid"]}), malformed dob input must be rejected with a deterministic 4xx client validation error (<CHECK_OPENAPI> / <CHECK_ERROR_REGISTRY>) and must never trigger HTTP 500.
- Existing profile record must remain unchanged on GET /api/traveler/me readback.

evidence.console: Test Case STAG-API-007 | Single-Variable Delta: dob ('2000-01-15' -> 'not-a-valid-date') | Profile readback verified unchanged.
evidence.notes: Frontend chunk 2k50va9an1vxz.js module 251583 calls PUT /api/traveler/update-profile. Backend passes unvalidated dob string into database date cast without pre-validation. | Security Classification: OWASP A10:2025 Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions (CWE-248, CWE-755) · OWASP API8:2023 Security Misconfiguration | OWASP Remediation: Validate ISO-8601 date schema prior to DB cast and handle parse failures via centralized 4xx error handler (https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Error_Handling_Cheat_Sheet.html).

classification: Confirmed Bug — Unhandled HTTP 500 Server Error on Malformed dob Input in PUT /api/traveler/update-profile
reproducibility: Always (100% — single-variable mutation verified on STAG)
